purpose: T63 second milestone: measure three new signal-hypothesis arms on the real PIT cohort, extending v1. Measurement only — no fitting, no trading. v1 runner and receipt are left untouched.

cohort.label: perp_forward_mark_return_up_25bps_1d_gross
cohort.derived_variable: next-day mark-price return from consecutive per-asset records (verified to reproduce the stored label on all eligible pairs)

h3_sharp_basis_close.expect: next-day mark return opposes sign(basis): P(sign agreement) > 0.5 and mean basis-closing-direction return > 0
h3_sharp_basis_close.note: non-tautological version of v1 H3; tests whether the mark leg, not just |basis|, converges

h4_volume_squeeze_proxy.rule: quote_volume z >= +2 trailing 180d AND |1-day mark return| below trailing-180d median |1d return|
h4_volume_squeeze_proxy.expect: next-day |return| expands vs rest; P(up) reported vs rest (direction agnostic)
h4_volume_squeeze_proxy.substitution: intended open_interest_level / open_interest_log_change_1d features are absent from this cohort; quote_volume z is the documented activity proxy

h5_taker_bottom.rule: taker_buy_ratio in bottom trailing-180d mid-rank decile
h5_taker_bottom.expect: next-day P(up > +25bps) differs from rest (contrarian long candidate)

h5_taker_top.rule: taker_buy_ratio in top trailing-180d mid-rank decile
h5_taker_top.expect: next-day P(up > +25bps) differs from rest (momentum/fade candidate)

statistics: mean basis-closing return with normal-approx t (H3-sharp)
pit_safety: trailing windows only; no forward data in feature construction; next-day returns used strictly as outcomes
